title: A comparative study of frustration in Al/P and B/P-based intramolecular frustrated Lewis pairs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35468-35478
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05892A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Santhosh Guntupalli, Mohmmad Faizan, Bhupendra Singh Bisht, Ravinder Pawar
The effect of bridging units on the frustration (i.e., reactivity) of Al/P and B/P based intramolecular frustrated Lewis pairs (IFLPs) have been systematically compared to unravel the key design principles for developing next generation of FLPs.
